title: Yéeg bu géntkat bi
intro: Ruuh buñu nara nekk nit ku mag, waaye natt ko ci fitna yu metti, mu dem ci tukki bu amul fenn. Yoonu nit ki bariwoon na fiiraange, tàqaloo, ak tiis wu jaarul yoon, mu dem ba mujjee nekk liggéey bu rëy ak ndaje bu xóot. Ndax mën nga xàmmee nit ku am solo kii ci Al Quran?
clues: Mus naa am ñi ma gënoon jege ci ñee, mu dem ba tàqaloo bu baax ak samay waajur ak sama kër.
Dama dundu jamono yu metti lool, lu ci melni tukkikat yi dañu ma jaay lu yomb.
Ñu jiiñ ma ni def naa lu jaaduwul, ñu jàpp ma ay at ci kaso, waaye sama ngëm baña yàqu.
Dañu ma jox mën-mën bu amul fenn ngir mëna tekki gis-gis yu jafee xam, te loolu nekkoon lu am solo ci sama yoonu moom sa bopp.
Sama xel mu ñaw ak sama njub moo ma mujj yóbbe ma njiit lu mag te wóolu ma ci jàmbur.
Ci ay xew-xew yu bari, ma gisantewaat ak samay waajur yu mag yi ak samay mbokk ginaaw bi ñu ma ñàkkee lu yàgg te metti.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Tabax gaal ngir muccal mbindéef yi
Muñ tuuma yu baaxul ak tëj
Janoo ak njiit luy jaay doole ak kéemtaanu
Natt leen ci feebar bu metti ak ñàkk
trial.answer: Muñ tuuma yu baaxul ak tëj

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Di jiite ab doxandéem ci réew mi Yàlla digoon
Nekk ministeer bu am doole ci Egypt
jot àtteb Yàlla ci kaw askan wu réy
Di yor réew mu yaatu ci xel mu dal ak yoon
outcome.answer: Nekk ministeer bu am doole ci Egypt

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
